# `device`

What an element becomes when it needs state of its own, or a machine standing alone: what it holds, its tags, modes, settings and stores, how fast and whether by itself it works recipes, and the know-how it provides (16 §4.2).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `holds` (object [`HoldsDef`](#holdsdef), or `null`; optional): What it holds (06 §9.2): its room by volume and mass and the tags it takes. Left out, nothing can be put in it.
- `tags` (list of string; optional): Tags the device entity carries.
- `interactions` (list of id of a [`interaction`](interaction.md); optional): The interactions the device entity offers (16 §3.2), done to it as an entity. Those of the element it is bound to are the element's.
- `modes` (list of string; optional): Named operating states (16 §4.2): the first is the one it starts in, and fields that say `when` apply in those named.
- `config` (list of object [`ConfigDef`](#configdef); optional): Settings a user may change (16 §4.2 `config`).
- `stores` (object, name → object [`StoreDef`](#storedef); optional): What it stores, by resource: a quantity it is filled with and draws on while it works (16 §5.2, without networks).
- `speed` ([`SpeedDef`](#speeddef), or `null`; optional): How fast it works recipes, and in which modes (16 §8.2). Left out, 1 in every mode.
- `auto` ([`AutoDef`](#autodef), or `null`; optional): Whether it runs recipes by itself, and in which modes (16 §8.2).
- `provides` (list of [`ProvidesDef`](#providesdef); optional): Know-how it provides to whoever works at it (16 §8.5): a manual built in, a pattern loaded.
- `recipes` (list of id of a [`recipe`](recipe.md); optional): The recipes it runs, in order of preference. Left out, every recipe whose `at` names one of its tags, in order of id.

<a id="holdsdef"></a>
### `HoldsDef`

An item's `holds`: its capacity as a container (06 §9.1).

- `volume` ([volume](../units.md#volume) in `m3`, or `null`; optional): The most space what is stowed in it may take up. Left out, any amount.
- `mass` ([mass](../units.md#mass) in `kg`, or `null`; optional): The most what is stowed in it may weigh, with everything inside that. Left out, any amount.
- `accepts` (list of string; optional): The tags it takes: an item goes in if it carries at least one of them. Empty for anything.
- `order` (one of `"first_in"`, `"last_in"` ([`StoreOrder`](#storeorder)), or `null`; optional): For a store (07 §11.5): the order it gives up what is stowed in it. Left out, it keeps no order, and equal things put in join whatever equal stack is there.

<a id="configdef"></a>
### `ConfigDef`

One setting of a device (16 §4.2 `config`).

- `id` (string; **required**): Its name: `self.config.<id>`.
- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a screen calls it.
- `kind` (one of `"flag"`, `"number"`, `"choice"`, `"text"` ([`ConfigKind`](#configkind)); **required**): What kind of value it holds.
- `default` ([`ConfigValue`](#configvalue), or `null`; optional): What it holds until it is set. Left out: false, 0, the first option, or empty.
- `options` (list of string; optional): For a choice, what it may be.
- `min` (number, or `null`; optional): For a number, the least it may be.
- `max` (number, or `null`; optional): For a number, the most it may be.

<a id="storedef"></a>
### `StoreDef`

A store of a resource (16 §5.2 `stores`).

- `capacity` (number; **required**): The most it holds, in the resource's unit.
- `start` (number; optional): What it holds when the device is made (default 0).
- `rate` (number, or `null`; optional): The most it gives a second, if it is limited: a machine that wants more works at the share it gets (16 §5.4).

<a id="speeddef"></a>
### `SpeedDef`

How fast a device works recipes (16 §8.2 `speed`): a number, or `{ "value": 1.0, "when": ["lit"] }`, outside whose modes it does not work at all.

Written as a number, or an object with `value` and `when`.

Takes:

- an object: object [`SpeedObject`](#speedobject)
- an integer
- a number

<a id="autodef"></a>
### `AutoDef`

Whether a device runs recipes by itself (16 §8.2 `auto`): `true`, or `{ "when": ["on"] }` for only in those modes.

Written as `true`, `false`, or an object with `when`.

Takes:

- an object: object [`WhenObject`](#whenobject)
- a boolean

<a id="providesdef"></a>
### `ProvidesDef`

Know-how a device provides (16 §8.5 `provides`): its id, or `{ "know_how": id, "when": [modes] }`.

Written as a know-how id, or an object with `know_how` and `when`.

Takes:

- a string: id of a [`know_how`](know_how.md)
- an object: object [`ProvidesObject`](#providesobject)

<a id="storeorder"></a>
### `StoreOrder`

The order a store gives up what is stowed in it (07 §11.5): a magazine, a quiver, a belt.

A store keeps what was put into it in the order it was put in. An equal thing put in joins only the stack put in last, so that two kinds of round loaded in turn stay in turn.

One of:

- `"first_in"`: What was put in first comes out first: a belt.
- `"last_in"`: What was put in last comes out first: a box magazine, a quiver.

<a id="configkind"></a>
### `ConfigKind`

The kinds of setting (16 §4.2 `config`).

One of:

- `"flag"`: On or off.
- `"number"`: A number, between `min` and `max` where they are given.
- `"choice"`: One of `options`.
- `"text"`: Any text.

<a id="configvalue"></a>
### `ConfigValue`

A plain value a setting holds, as data writes it.

Written as `true`, `false`, a number or a text.

Takes:

- a string
- an integer
- a number
- a boolean

<a id="speedobject"></a>
### `SpeedObject`

`speed` written as an object: a factor that holds only in some modes.

- `value` (number; optional): The factor on the rate of work done at the device, 1 if left out.
- `when` (list of string; optional): The modes, by name, in which the device works at this speed; in every other mode it does not work at all. Empty or left out: every mode.

<a id="whenobject"></a>
### `WhenObject`

`auto` written as an object: the device runs recipes by itself only in some modes.

- `when` (list of string; optional): The modes, by name, in which the device runs recipes by itself. Empty or left out: every mode.

<a id="providesobject"></a>
### `ProvidesObject`

`provides` written as an object: know-how the device provides only in some modes.

- `know_how` (id of a [`know_how`](know_how.md); optional): The know-how provided to whoever works at the device.
- `when` (list of string; optional): The modes, by name, in which the device provides it. Empty or left out: every mode.
